verdict.rationale: Zero documents asking questions about mailbox content and about specific threads, and its founder describes users chatting with their inbox, so inbox-wide Q&A is a first-party capability. Nothing covers calendar data, and nothing shows how answers are grounded (for example, cited source emails) or how well queries like 'what's outstanding' work. missing for 10: calendar coverage, evidence of grounded/cited answers, hands-on or independent corroboration of answer quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers
